t: You're at Stepney All Saints Church of England Secondary School, a voluntary aided school with a sixth form, in Stepney. Its last Ofsted report, in October 2015, rated it Outstanding. The school is named for Sir John Cass, a merchant, Tory Member of Parliament and philanthropist, who lived from 1666 to 1718. He was also a key figure in the Royal African Company, which was involved in the Atlantic slave trade. That history is part of why his name here is a subject of discussion.
